home.hero: Asymmetric layout. Left side: Tagline ('Every child is capable...') in large Fraunces h1, secondary gold CTA button. Right side: Generated flatlay image of desk/worksheets overlapping a navy background block. Background should be warm ivory (#FDFBF7).

home.subjects_grid: Bento box grid featuring the 4 subjects (Maths, English, Science, SST). Cards must use the exact assigned hex codes as solid background colors, with white text.
home.testimonials: Carousel of parent reviews on ivory/cream cards. Warm, trustworthy vibe.
home.newsletter_cta: Deep navy background section (#1B3A6B) with gold accents. Large serif heading for trust, clean input field for email.

ecommerce.catalog: Sidebar layout. Left sidebar: Collapsible filters for Grade (KG-IX), Subject, and Level (Easy/Moderate/Difficult). Right side: Grid of product cards.

dashboard_admin.layout: Sidebar navigation. White background with sharp grey borders (Archetype 4). Dense data tables for orders and worksheets.
dashboard_admin.forms: Detailed forms to upload PDFs, set Grade/Subject/Level, specify price, upload sample preview.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Google Fonts: 'Fraunces' (weights 400,500,600) for all headings, and 'Manrope' (weights 400,500,600) for body text.
Stick STRICTLY to the brand colors provided: Primary Navy #1B3A6B, Primary Gold #BA7517.
Map subjects EXACTLY to these colors: English #4472C4, Maths #70AD47, Science #ED7D31, SST #534AB7. Use these as background colors for subject cards or pill badges.
Map difficulty levels EXACTLY to: Easy #E2EFDA, Moderate #FFF2CC, Difficult #FCE4D6.
Do NOT use pure white backgrounds for main layout areas; lean into warm ivory #FDFBF7 for the main page backgrounds to feel premium, soft, and educator-crafted.
Every interactive element MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='add-to-cart-btn').

Use Shadcn UI for standard components like forms, tabs, and admin elements. However, use raw HTML/Tailwind for marketing sections (Hero, Features) to ensure a bespoke 'Heritage' feel without generic SaaS constraints.
Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, Poppins, Space Grotesk, or Montserrat anywhere. Ensure Tailwind config sets Fraunces as 'font-heading' and Manrope as 'font-body'.
Include a floating WhatsApp button fixed to the bottom right of the screen for customer support.
The hero section MUST prominently display the exact tagline: 'Every child is capable — of learning at their pace, in their place.'
Maintain high accessibility (contrast) - especially over colored subject blocks. Ensure text on #1B3A6B is white/ivory.
Ensure the Admin Panel is fully separate (e.g., under /admin) from the customer facing store.
For difficulty indicators, accompany the pill badges with visual stars (★, ★★, ★★★) where applicable to reinforce the level visually.
